title: Global Sparsity and Layer-wise Budget Allocation
analysis: All candidates used approximately 50.0% global sparsity. Held-out RMSE was 0.067273 for uniform, 0.062327 for global magnitude, and 0.061447 for the sensitivity-adjusted allocation. The calibration sweep identified `4.weight` as most sensitive. This validates the budget experiment, not optimality of the heuristic.
conclusion: A global target needs a measured allocation rule; uniform layer rates are merely one candidate.
